title: Vocabulary & Grammar · Lớp 11 · Daily Routines
description: 25 câu trắc nghiệm & điền từ về thói quen hàng ngày, luyện tập từ vựng và thì Hiện tại đơn.

parts.name: Phần 1 · Trắc nghiệm đục lỗ
parts.hint: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất A, B, C hoặc D.

questions.q: Every morning, Tom's alarm rings at 6:00 AM, but he usually ________ at 6:15 AM.
Nina doesn't have a car, so she always ________  number 11 to go to college.
After dinner, my father often ________ in front of the TV to watch the news.
My brother is very helpful. He always ________ after we finish eating dinner.
At 12:00 PM, the professor gives a long ________ about history at the university.
Sarah ________ dinner for her family because she loves cooking.
Sometimes, my dad ________ me a lift to school when it rains.
He works late until ________, so he feels very tired the next morning.
Everyday, my sister ________ her teeth twice to keep them healthy.
When staying in England, Peter lived with a very friendly ________.

parts.name: Phần 2 · Điền từ có khung cho sẵn
parts.hint: Chọn từ thích hợp trong khung và chia đúng dạng thì Hiện tại đơn (nếu là động từ).

questions.q: Every evening before going to bed, I usually ________ to read news and chat with my friends on Facebook.
The house is very dirty! Can you help me ________ and clean the floor?
Don't leave your clothes on the floor! Please ________ into your closet.
Every Sunday, my mom ________ to clean all our dirty clothes.
It is 11:00 PM. He is very tired, so he usually ________ right after lying on his bed.
On weekends, foreign tourists love to ________ around Ho Chi Minh City to take pictures.
He always has a quick ________ in the morning to feel refreshed before work.
At 12:30 PM, my grandmother usually ________ for the whole family.

parts.name: Phần 3 · Tự điền từ không cho sẵn
parts.hint: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh, tự suy luận từ vựng/cụm từ thích hợp và chia đúng dạng thì Hiện tại đơn để hoàn thành câu.

questions.q: After getting out of bed, I go to the bathroom to brush my teeth and ________ a shower.
My brother is lazy; he never ________ out the rubbish, so the bin is always full.
On Saturdays, I like to ________ a friend for coffee at a small café near my house. (gặp)
What time do you usually ________ to bed at night? - Around 10:30 PM.
She is learning how to drive, so her dad ________ her out for a driving lesson every weekend.
Before going to school, I always ________ my schoolbag ready with books and pens.
We don't have a dishwasher, so my sister ________ the dishes by hand after every meal.
